variables.input:
metrics 
| filter metric.key == "buoy.info"
| filter isNotNull(buoy_id)
| fields buoy_id
| dedup buoy_id

hdr_overview.content:
## 🌊 Ocean Sensor Network — Live Telemetry
Use the **Buoy** dropdown above to filter to one or more buoys. All tiles update every 5 seconds.

tile_buoy_map.title: Buoy Positions — Live Map
tile_buoy_map.query:
timeseries {
  latitude  = avg(`buoy.latitude`),
  longitude = avg(`buoy.longitude`)
}, by: {buoy_id}, from: now()-5m
| filter isNull(array($buoy)[0]) or in(buoy_id, array($buoy))
| fields buoy_id,
         latitude  = arrayLast(latitude),
         longitude = arrayLast(longitude),
         buoy_num  = toLong(subString(buoy_id, from: 5))

tile_status_snapshot.title: Sensor Status Snapshot
tile_status_snapshot.query:
timeseries {
  surface_temp = avg(`buoy.ocean.surface.temp.celsius`),
  co2_ppm      = avg(`buoy.atm.co2.ppm`),
  ph           = avg(`buoy.ocean.ph`),
  dissolved_o2 = avg(`buoy.ocean.dissolved.oxygen.mgl`),
  water_level  = avg(`buoy.tidal.water.level.meters`),
  wave_hs      = avg(`buoy.wave.significant.height.meters`),
  wind_speed   = avg(`buoy.atm.wind.speed.knots`),
  pressure     = avg(`buoy.atm.pressure.hpa`),
  salinity     = avg(`buoy.ocean.salinity.psu`),
  current_spd  = avg(`buoy.current.surface.speed.knots`)
}, by: {buoy_id}, from: now()-5m
| filter isNull(array($buoy)[0]) or in(buoy_id, array($buoy))
| fields buoy_id,
         surface_temp_c      = arrayLast(surface_temp),
         co2_ppm             = arrayLast(co2_ppm),
         ocean_ph            = arrayLast(ph),
         dissolved_o2_mgl    = arrayLast(dissolved_o2),
         water_level_m       = arrayLast(water_level),
         wave_height_hs_m    = arrayLast(wave_hs),
         wind_speed_kn       = arrayLast(wind_speed),
         pressure_hpa        = arrayLast(pressure),
         salinity_psu        = arrayLast(salinity),
         current_speed_kn    = arrayLast(current_spd)

tile_buoy_count.title: Active Buoys
tile_buoy_count.query:
timeseries count(`buoy.info`), by: {buoy_id}
| filter isNull(array($buoy)[0]) or in(buoy_id, array($buoy))

tile_update_rate.title: Telemetry Update Rate
tile_update_rate.query:
timeseries count(`buoy.ocean.surface.temp.celsius`), by: {buoy_id}
| filter isNull(array($buoy)[0]) or in(buoy_id, array($buoy))

hdr_tidal.content:
## 🌊 Tidal Data
Water level · Rate of change · Tidal range · Next slack

tile_tidal_chart.title: Water Level & Tidal Rate

tile_tidal_raw.title: Tidal — Current Values
tile_tidal_raw.query:
timeseries {
  lvl   = avg(`buoy.tidal.water.level.meters`),
  rate  = avg(`buoy.tidal.rate.cm.per.hour`),
  range = avg(`buoy.tidal.range.meters`),
  next  = avg(`buoy.tidal.next.change.minutes`)
}, by: {buoy_id}, from: now()-5m
| filter isNull(array($buoy)[0]) or in(buoy_id, array($buoy))
| fields buoy_id,
         water_level_m       = arrayLast(lvl),
         tidal_rate_cm_hr    = arrayLast(rate),
         tidal_range_m       = arrayLast(range),
         next_slack_minutes  = arrayLast(next)

hdr_atmospheric.content:
## 🌬️ Atmospheric Data
CO₂ concentration · Barometric pressure · Air temperature · Wind · Humidity · Solar irradiance

tile_atm_co2_pressure.title: CO₂ & Barometric Pressure

tile_atm_wind_temp.title: Wind, Air Temperature & Humidity

tile_atm_raw.title: Atmospheric — Current Values
tile_atm_raw.query:
timeseries {
  co2      = avg(`buoy.atm.co2.ppm`),
  pres     = avg(`buoy.atm.pressure.hpa`),
  atemp    = avg(`buoy.atm.air.temp.celsius`),
  wspd     = avg(`buoy.atm.wind.speed.knots`),
  wdir     = avg(`buoy.atm.wind.direction.degrees`),
  hum      = avg(`buoy.atm.humidity.percent`),
  solar    = avg(`buoy.atm.solar.irradiance.wm2`)
}, by: {buoy_id}, from: now()-5m
| filter isNull(array($buoy)[0]) or in(buoy_id, array($buoy))
| fields buoy_id,
         co2_ppm             = arrayLast(co2),
         pressure_hpa        = arrayLast(pres),
         air_temp_c          = arrayLast(atemp),
         wind_speed_kn       = arrayLast(wspd),
         wind_direction_deg  = arrayLast(wdir),
         humidity_pct        = arrayLast(hum),
         solar_irradiance_wm2 = arrayLast(solar)

hdr_oceanographic.content:
## 🔬 Oceanographic Data
Surface & subsurface temperature · Salinity · pH · Dissolved oxygen · Turbidity · Chlorophyll · Dissolved CO₂

tile_ocean_temp_salinity.title: Temperature & Salinity

tile_ocean_ph_o2.title: pH, Dissolved Oxygen & Turbidity

tile_ocean_raw.title: Oceanographic — Current Values
tile_ocean_raw.query:
timeseries {
  st  = avg(`buoy.ocean.surface.temp.celsius`),
  sst = avg(`buoy.ocean.subsurface.temp.celsius`),
  sal = avg(`buoy.ocean.salinity.psu`),
  ph  = avg(`buoy.ocean.ph`),
  do2 = avg(`buoy.ocean.dissolved.oxygen.mgl`),
  trb = avg(`buoy.ocean.turbidity.ntu`),
  chl = avg(`buoy.ocean.chlorophyll.ugl`),
  dc2 = avg(`buoy.ocean.dissolved.co2.umol`)
}, by: {buoy_id}, from: now()-5m
| filter isNull(array($buoy)[0]) or in(buoy_id, array($buoy))
| fields buoy_id,
         surface_temp_c       = arrayLast(st),
         subsurface_temp_c    = arrayLast(sst),
         salinity_psu         = arrayLast(sal),
         ph_level             = arrayLast(ph),
         dissolved_o2_mgl     = arrayLast(do2),
         turbidity_ntu        = arrayLast(trb),
         chlorophyll_ugl      = arrayLast(chl),
         dissolved_co2_umol   = arrayLast(dc2)

hdr_wave.content:
## 🌀 Wave Data
Significant wave height (Hs) · Max wave height · Peak period (Tp) · Swell · Wave direction

tile_wave_heights.title: Wave Heights & Period

tile_wave_raw.title: Wave — Current Values
tile_wave_raw.query:
timeseries {
  hs    = avg(`buoy.wave.significant.height.meters`),
  hmax  = avg(`buoy.wave.max.height.meters`),
  tp    = avg(`buoy.wave.peak.period.seconds`),
  wdir  = avg(`buoy.wave.direction.degrees`),
  swell = avg(`buoy.wave.swell.height.meters`)
}, by: {buoy_id}, from: now()-5m
| filter isNull(array($buoy)[0]) or in(buoy_id, array($buoy))
| fields buoy_id,
         significant_wave_hs_m  = arrayLast(hs),
         max_wave_height_m      = arrayLast(hmax),
         peak_period_tp_s       = arrayLast(tp),
         wave_direction_deg     = arrayLast(wdir),
         swell_height_m         = arrayLast(swell)

hdr_current.content:
## 🌊 Ocean Currents
Surface & subsurface current speed/direction · Vertical current (upwelling/downwelling)

tile_current_chart.title: Surface & Subsurface Currents

tile_current_raw.title: Currents — Current Values
tile_current_raw.query:
timeseries {
  ss  = avg(`buoy.current.surface.speed.knots`),
  sd  = avg(`buoy.current.surface.direction.degrees`),
  sbs = avg(`buoy.current.subsurface.speed.knots`),
  sbd = avg(`buoy.current.subsurface.direction.degrees`),
  vc  = avg(`buoy.current.vertical.cm.per.sec`)
}, by: {buoy_id}, from: now()-5m
| filter isNull(array($buoy)[0]) or in(buoy_id, array($buoy))
| fields buoy_id,
         surface_speed_kn      = arrayLast(ss),
         surface_direction_deg  = arrayLast(sd),
         subsurface_speed_kn    = arrayLast(sbs),
         subsurface_dir_deg     = arrayLast(sbd),
         vertical_cm_per_sec    = arrayLast(vc)
